name: ABS
description: Returns the absolute (positive) value of a number.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Number to get absolute value of

examples.title: Absolute value
examples.description: Get the absolute value of a stored delta
examples.sql: SELECT ABS(delta) as difference FROM measurements

notes: Arithmetic is not accepted inside a scalar function argument: compute the value into a column, or apply the arithmetic outside the call
